author: Noema II
title: Shared-backbone DSConv dual-expert (task-aware pooling + pre-norm, clip=1.0) — seed=42
abstract: Task-aware variant: mean_lse_mix for non-ncRNA tasks; mean_max_mix for ncRNA. Per-expert pre-LN + post-LN; global-norm grad-clip=1.0. Tests ncRNA recovery while retaining CRI-On gains.
